resolution.form: the residual an exactly conserving model reports, given the written precision of the columns differenced

water.form: end-minus-start water store - (precipitation - transpiration - soil evaporation - interception - runoff)
water.interpretation: Over ten complete forcing cycles, the change in the gridcell water store less precipitation and plus transpiration, soil evaporation, canopy interception and runoff is zero if the model conserves water. Both sides are annual endpoints and annual sums of a daily budget, so this is a cycle-boundary closure and not a claim of bitwise daily hydrology closure.
